answer: Agents establish 1,000 unique identities by reserving 1,000 distinct server compute slots, structured like a geometric terrace to prevent overlapping occupancy. A central verifier audits each slot against a high-bandwidth river of input requests, penalizing any agent failing a latency check. Like an orchard requires specific spacing for harvest, each identity incurs 1x cost for one unit, while fakes pay 1,000x for isolation.
